Title:
Rock On 48 Ultimate Rockin Collection Mineral Specimens Set Guide Tray
Department:
Collectibles & Art
Condition:
Used
Category:
Collectibles & Art
Description:
Bring home an exciting educational experience with this 48-piece rock and mineral collection kit. The set includes an original display box, a blue plastic tray with 48 slots (a few may be missing stones), and a colorful fold-out poster with vivid images and information for each rock and mineral featured in the collection. Included are a variety of polished and raw stones, from classic rose quartz to unique textured specimens and a heart-shaped clear stone. The kit offers a wonderful visual and tactile variety for collectors, students, or those curious about geology. Each item is photographed to display its specific characteristics, while the included guide enhances learning and identification for each stone. The set as shown is in used condition with some stones potentially missing and visible wear to the packaging. Perfect for an educational gift, a hands-on science tool, or a starter set for amateur collectors

280005565.description:
Natural History Specimen
Four Polished Petrified Wood Slices
Fossilized Wood and Mineralized Silica
Approximately 16" x 12" x 11" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This collection of four polished petrified wood slices showcases the intricate process of permineralization, where organic wood fibers are replaced by minerals over millions of years while retaining the original cellular structure. Each specimen displays distinct annual growth rings and vibrant color variations ranging from deep onyx blacks to warm ochre and cream, typical of ancient coniferous or hardwood species. The faces have been polished to a high luster, revealing crystalline structures and unique geological signatures, while the perimeters retain the rugged, natural texture of fossilized bark.
Professionally polished faces highlighting internal mineral structures and growth patterns
Natural rough-hewn edges providing a stark contrast between raw earth and refined surface
Substantial total weight of 24 pounds suitable for architectural display or specimen collection
Condition:
Very good condition with stable mineral structures. As natural specimens, these pieces exhibit inherent fissures, inclusions, and voids characteristic of the fossilization process. Surfaces are polished to a high gloss with minimal abrasions and the specimens remain structurally sound.

280685500.description:
Various Mineral Specimens
Eclectic Geological and Decorative Stone Collection
Natural Stone, Slag Glass, and Metal
7.8 lbs Total Weight
Unsigned
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of geological specimens and decorative stone objects, weighing a total of 7.8 pounds. The lot is anchored by a significant piece of cobalt blue cullet or slag glass, prized for its intense coloration and characteristic glassy conchoidal fracture. Accompanying the raw specimens is a curated selection of polished tumbled stones, including rose quartz, snowflake obsidian, amethyst, and iron pyrite, providing a broad survey of mineral textures and colors. A polished green stone egg and a set of stone-topped picks add a decorative functional element to the assembly.
Set of 9 metal decorative forks/picks featuring various stone cabochon handles including carnelian and quartz
Wide variety of minerals ranging from raw crystalline quartz and field specimens to polished aventurine and obsidian
Substantial cobalt blue slag glass specimen with characteristic swirling textures and vibrant translucency
Condition:
Good overall condition. Natural mineral specimens exhibit raw, unpolished edges as naturally occurring. Tumbled stones are smooth with high-luster finishes. The slag glass piece is stable with sharp edges typical of the material. Metal picks show light surface wear and minor oxidation consistent with age and previous handling.
